honestLimits: The chord sheet is BTC's reading, not a human's: 0.786 root accuracy on synthetic audio (PR-85); the lead did not verify the 92 chords by ear.
Sections were placed by the lead from chord/energy structure - a musical judgement, not a measurement; no structure provider is live.
Melody remains not_available: the Brain arranges the harmony and form, not around the sung line.

trusted_automatically here means 'every field confirmed by a producer', which is exactly what happened; it does not mean the analysis was right on its own - v1 was wrong on tempo (half) and contested on key.
v6 is still REFERENCE_PART_COMPOSER_V1 output: root-position triads, roots in the bass, strings at MIDI 79-91, no counter-line, chorus 2 = chorus 1.
The balance was the lead's producer decision through the mix controls; the mix plan's default put the bass 5 dB above everything.
The sound selection brain ignores an asset's playable range; the revision evidence names no per-stem renderer; exported MIDI GM programs are wrong.
No human has judged v6 blind; the band-share and envelope measurements say it is audible and balanced, not that it is good.
